about_the_game:
Can you go from dusty streets to global superstardom?

In The Final Kick, you are a young boy born into poverty in Brazil with nothing but a dream and a talent for football. This is your story, your journey.

  • Live the Dream: Start as a kid playing in the favelas, get scouted, and rise through the ranks of Brazilian football.

  • Conquer Europe: Make your mark in the big leagues of France, England, and Spain. Can you become a world-class star?

  • Overcome Adversity: The path to glory is never easy. Face unexpected challenges and tough decisions that could change everything.

  • Achieve Glory: Lift your family out of hardship, chase the biggest trophies in club football, and fight for the ultimate honor with the Brazilian national team.

  • Your Legacy Awaits: Experience the highs and lows of a football legend's career. Every match, every goal, every decision shapes your path.

Features:

  • Engaging story-driven gameplay with impactful cutscenes.

  • Progress your player through multiple leagues and countries.

  • Experience dramatic moments of triumph and challenge.

  • Simple, heartfelt pixel art style.

Will your final kick be the one that defines a generation?

Your journey from nothing to legend starts now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+)
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10 capable
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 capable
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
